create_vector3: create a 3D vector from x, y, z values using the Create function
normalize_vector3: normalize a 3D vector to unit length using the Normalize function
slerp_vector3: spherically interpolate between two 3D vectors using the Slerp function
signed_angle_vector3: compute the signed angle between two 3D vectors around a given axis
transform_direction: transform a 3D direction vector between coordinate spaces using DirectionFrom and DirectionTo
